disambiguation: Not a general AI assistant; it is specifically designed for long-form manuscript development within Obsidian.
intentEvidence: A writing partner for your long-form work in Obsidian.
problem: Writing long-form content requires maintaining consistency and context across many notes, which is difficult with standard note-taking tools.
summary: Writing Buddy is an AI writing partner that assists users in writing and revising long-form work by providing manuscript context and reviewable AI edits.
